# Session Reflection Solution Design
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Data

Create `session_reflections` with `learning_session_id`, `user_id`, `body`, nullable `edited_at`, timestamps, foreign-key cascade behavior, and a unique `(learning_session_id, user_id)` constraint. Add Eloquent relationships to LearningSession and User.

## Server behavior

Add a session reflection controller with protected store, update, and delete routes. Reuse the existing published and non-archived session visibility check. Validate a trimmed, required string up to 5,000 characters. Permit updates only to the author. Permit deletion to the author or an administrator. Enforce session ownership on every mutation and retain the unique database constraint as the final duplicate-submission guard. Record creation, update, and deletion activity without reflection text in metadata.

Load reflections with their authors on the session detail response. Place the current user's reflection first, then other reflections newest first. Expose only author, role, body, creation date, edited state, and server-derived edit/delete permissions.

## UI behavior

Add a third `Reflection` tab beside `Session Materials` and `Q&A`. Show the audience notice, required textarea, character limit, empty state, current-user reflection, other reflections, author controls, edited marker, confirmation before deletion, and live success/error feedback. Render body text with preserved whitespace as text. Keep existing tab and recording behavior unchanged.

## Verification

Add feature tests for persistence, isolation, validation, duplicate requests, editing, deletion, authorization, unavailable sessions, administrator deletion, and activity logging. Run the existing PHP, static, frontend, build, and diff checks. Review keyboard use, narrow layouts, and safe text rendering when browser tooling is available.
